desc:
🚑 You’re the paramedic. Answer 911 calls across the town of Millbrook and keep your patients alive until the hospital takes over.

Ride with your EMS partner through traffic with lights and siren. Then work out what’s wrong and treat it with real equipment:
• Read the ECG and take vital signs
• CPR and the defibrillator
• Oxygen and IVs
• Splints and tourniquets
• Blood and TXA for internal bleeding

Every call is different: heart attacks, strokes, seizures, crashes with police on scene, cardiac arrests on the freeway, and patients who refuse to go to hospital.

📚 Take courses to unlock new kinds of calls
🔧 Upgrade your ambulance
⭐ Earn badges and climb the weekly leaderboards
💰 Daily shift bonus and hot-streak rewards
🕐 Rush hour every 8 hours: 1.5x pay and XP
📖 A Field Guide teaches you everything

Play on PC, mobile, tablet, and Xbox, and bring friends on shift!
